summary: Iter125 - End-to-end tested CRMEvent Partner portal (backend + preview UI). Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter125_partner_portal.py: 21/21 PASSED on https://manage-events-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified: (1) GET /api/partner/public-config returns 10%/12mo + bronze/silver/gold yearly 182.4/470.4/758.4 → simulator math default yearly 5/3/1 = 308.16 €; (2) POST /api/partner/register (privato) succeeds, pending status, 8-char code, partner_token cookie set; azienda without P.IVA → 400; missing accept_terms → 400; duplicate email → 400; (3) GET /api/partner/me OK, GET /api/partner/dashboard = 403 while pending with detail.code='partner_not_approved'; (4) Cookie isolation: partner_token alone → /api/auth/me 401; SA access_token/session_token → /api/partner/me 401; (5) SA /api/platform/partner-settings GET+PUT roundtrip (12.5/6/ordinario then restored); non-SA → /api/platform/partners 401/403; (6) SA /api/platform/partners lists new partner; POST /partners/{id}/status approved → dashboard 200 with referral_link ending in '?ref=CODE' and totals; (7) 5+ wrong /partner/login → 429 lockout; good password after fresh partner → 200 + cookie; logout clears cookie; (8) Referral attach: POST /api/auth/register-organization with ref=CODE → partner dashboard totals.referrals ≥ 1 and org appears in referrals list; self-ref (partner's own email) is ignored by attach_referral; (9) commission_base_cents({amount_paid:22253,total_taxes:[{amount:4013}]}) == 18240 (spec match); (10) on_subscription_paid creates ONE commission per invoice (idempotent on second call), 10% of base = 1824, status maturata, snapshots crmevent_tax_regime + partner_fiscal; (11) on_refund 50% halves commission_net_cents to 912 with status maturata; full refund → commission_net_cents=0, status='stornata'; (12) SA mark /api/platform/partner-commissions/{id}/paid → status 'pagata', double-call → 400. Playwright preview UI at /api/partner-preview/: landing-page + hero-register + commission-simulator + sliders bronze/silver/gold + cycle semester/yearly + simulator-total='308,16 €' (default yearly) and '385,20 €' (default semester) all render; mobile 390×844 has NO horizontal overflow (scrollW=390=winW=390). Registration form (/registrati) fields input-nome/cognome/email/password/telefono/tipo-privato/accept-terms/register-submit all work → dashboard shows partner-pending card, no referral-card, GET /api/partner/dashboard returns 403 (verified via page.evaluate). SA /piattaforma?sezione=partner tab 'Partner' renders platform-section-partner with partner-settings-pct/months/regime/save present. All TEST_ data cleaned (verified 0 partners/orgs/commissions remain). partner-settings restored to 10%/12/forfettario.
critical_code_review_comments: partner_portal.py:38 commission_base_cents correctly excludes imposte (total_taxes[].amount summed, else `tax`, else 0) and never assumes IVA — matches 'regime forfettario' spec.
partner_portal.py:262 on_subscription_paid guards idempotency via unique stripe_invoice_id lookup; snapshots crmevent_tax_regime + partner_fiscal onto each commission for auditability. Good.

partner_portal.py:275 commission_until window is enforced strictly — a payment arriving AFTER commission_until is silently skipped. Consider logging this (currently no log) so SA can tell apart 'window expired' vs 'duplicate' vs 'no referral'.

partner_portal.py:291 on_refund correctly recomputes commission_net_cents from refunded ratio, flips status to 'stornata' only when net==0, and accumulates recupero_cents when the commission was already paid. Edge-safe.

partner_portal.py:250 attach_referral correctly: strips non-alphanumeric, requires APPROVED status, rejects self-referral (p.email == user_email), rejects duplicate (one referral per org_id). All good.

partner_portal.py:189 brute-force lockout: 5 wrong attempts then 15-min lock keyed by `host:email`. In K8s with multi-pod ingress the key may rotate per pod and allow more attempts than 5 at the edge — acceptable, but consider using X-Forwarded-For (first hop) for a stable identifier.

partner_portal.py:138 partner_token cookie set with samesite=none,secure=true,httponly=true — correct for cross-domain partner.crmevent.it. Verified not accepted by main /auth/me (401) and vice-versa.
partner_portal.py:378 /partner-preview served only when PARTNER_PREVIEW_DIR is set and index.html exists — dev-only behavior preserved; path-traversal guarded by `base in f.parents` resolve check.

server.py:755 register-organization calls PARTNER['attach_referral'] with the main user email — when a partner registers an org USING THEIR OWN email as `ref`, attach_referral returns False but the org is still created (expected: not a referral blocker). No change needed, but main agent may want to document this edge case.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (landing + simulator math + mobile + registration pending + SA tab)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable: /app/backend/tests/test_iter125_partner_portal.py (21 tests, ~8s) covers public-config/simulator math, partner register/login/logout/me/dashboard-pending, cookie isolation both directions, SA settings PUT+roundtrip, SA approve + listing, 429 brute-force lockout, referral attach via /auth/register-organization?ref=CODE, self-ref ignore, commission_base_cents, on_subscription_paid idempotent, on_refund partial+full, SA mark-paid + double-paid-400, and TEST_ cleanup incl. a second TEST_ org created by self-ref. Run: cd /app && DB_NAME=test_database pytest -o addopts='' backend/tests/test_iter125_partner_portal.py -v. The test loads /app/backend/.env for JWT_SECRET so partner_portal.build() works inside pytest. Google partner login was NOT UI-tested (provider is 'emergent' in preview so the Google partner button is hidden per spec). Preview build location: /app/partner-frontend/build (served at /api/partner-preview/). To rebuild preview after FE edits: cd /app/partner-frontend && CI=false yarn build:preview.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — pure feature verification. All partner portal flows (API + UI preview + commission engine + SA ops + cookie isolation) behave as specified. Minor observation: self-referral by a partner's own email creates a main-app Organization but correctly skips the partner_referral row — intended behavior per attach_referral guard; worth documenting.
